title: Payroll Assistant
description:
Payroll Assistant (Temporary 3-6 Month Contract)
- Location: Warrington (Hybrid Working)
- Salary: £14.87 - £17.44 per hour DOE
- Contract: Temporary, 3-6 Months
- Start Date: ASAP
- Reporting To: Payroll Manager

We are currently recruiting for a Payroll Assistant to join a well-established organisation based in Warrington on a temporary basis for an initial 3-6-month period.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting with the processing of monthly payroll information.
- Maintaining accurate employee payroll records and data.
- Processing starters, leavers and employee amendments.
- Supporting the administration of statutory payments including sickness, maternity and paternity pay.
- Handling payroll-related queries from employees and managers.
- Assisting with pension administration activities.
- Producing payroll reports and supporting data analysis.

Requirements
- Previous experience within a payroll, payroll administration or finance administration position.
- Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- The ability to manage workloads and work to strict deadlines.

If you are an experienced Payroll Assistant or Payroll Administrator available at short notice and looking for your next opportunity in Warrington, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Payroll Senior Administrator
description:
The Opportunity:

Butler Rose are delighted to represent a great opportunity as Payroll Senior Administrator within an a friendly firm who are currently expanding their payroll team at their office in the Widnes area. this role is available to experienced candidates and is offered on either a full time or part time basis, offering flexible start and finish times for that extra work life balance!

If you an experienced Payroll professional with full end to end payroll processing background ideally within a bureau/bureau services or similar environment, seeking to join a supportive, progressive environment, where your experience matters and the opportunity to further you payroll skillset and career - this is for you!

The Role:

Working as part of a busy, friendly team dealing with payroll processing for both small and large payrolls, you will build great relationships in this varied role, passionate about giving an exceptional service. You will receive full payroll system training on payroll systems together with supportive management from the Payroll Manager and your team colleagues.

Key Duties:
- Process end to end payrolls at multiple intervals, auto enrolment pensions
- Deliver accurate, compliant payroll services on time, liaising with HMRC, and pension providers.
- BACS submissions, PAYE, CIS
- Holiday pay, SMP/SSP
- Starters/leavers, P45/P46/P60
- PAYE
- Dealing with SMP/SSP/SPP
- Calculating statutory payments
- Keeping up to date with payroll legislation.

Knowledge and Experience Required:
- Solid expertise in end to end Payroll and auto-enrolment pension procedures/legislation with proven experience working in busy payroll departments running both small and volume employee payrolls.
- Strong and effective communication skills.
- Great attention to detail, solid organisational and time management skills.
- Able to remain calm whilst working to deadlines
- Able to deal with queries both over the telephone/email in a professional and helpful manner
- Knowledge of payroll software and Excel (a must)
- A proactive, friendly personality, eager to develop your payroll skills and career to the next level.

2-3yrs+ previous experience in Payroll running full end to end payroll processing at multiple intervals
Able to work as part of an effective team.

Salary & Benefits:

c£30 K-£33 K (doe) (if part time this salary will be pro rata)

Pension
Healthcare
Generous holidays!
CIPP funded training
Free parking

If you are ready to step up your experience in payroll and join a rewarding, progressive firm that values skills, offers payroll system training and future career opportunities, then this is one is for you! Don't delay, apply today.

Butler Rose is committed to equality in the workplace and is an equal opportunity employer.
Butler Rose Ltd is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper/Accounts Assistant - Widnes, Cheshire

Our client is seeking an experienced Accountancy Practice Bookkeeper to joint their team based in their Widnes office.

This successful firm of accountants has developed a strong reputation for delivering quality services, along with building strong relationships with its wide-ranging client bases, across varying industries and size of client. The firm offers a very supportive and team focused environment, reflected by a low staff turnover and long serving staff.

Joining this firm of accountants as a Bookkeeper based from their Dudley office, you will carve a key, hands on role, as you develop within this firm and environment. Acting for varied sole trader, partnership and limited company SME's and OMB's of varying size and industry sector, you will deliver bookkeeping, management accounts, VAT and other services to mixed clients.

As an Accountancy Bookkeeper, you will be responsible for:
- Processing day to day bookkeeping for a portfolio of clients including limited companies, Sole traders and Partnerships as well as reconciliations of the main control accounts
- Preparing monthly management accounts
- Dealing with client queries
- Preparing and filing VAT returns
- Attending client premises to undertake bookkeeping role on-site which includes preparation of management information for clients
- Providing training to clients on various packages and bookkeeping skills as required
- Training and supporting apprentices with general bookkeeping skills

Requirements

You may be AAT studying, qualified, or qualified by experience.

You will have anything from 3 - 5 years + experience within bookkeeping within a client-facing capacity, either in practice, a bureau or self-employed.

Experience of software such as Xero, Quickbooks, Sage, Kashflow etc. would be advantageous.
